text:
Situation: Etomidate 2 mg/mL 10 mL vials are in shortage at Corvale East (7.6 days on hand) while Corvale General holds 17 days and Corvale Lakeside holds 20–24 days. FDA first posted the etomidate shortage on 2022-10-05 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA’s shortage list shows etomidate Current since 2022-10-05. The Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) plant that manufactures the Civica product used at Corvale General was inspected on 2023-02-03 (VAI, 121 days after posting) and again on 2023-04-21 (VAI, 198 days after posting). Hospira, Inc. received a Warning Letter on 2010-04-12 and multiple OAI inspections in 2010–2011; its most recent inspection on 2025-02-07 was NAI.

Our position: Corvale East inventory is below the two‑week target. Corvale General can spare 70 vials and still retain two weeks. An alternate Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. product is approved for use with pharmacist verification and dose recalculation. A Civica, Inc. alternate NDC is also approved with pharmacist verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 70 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by Pharmacy Director.
2. Procure etomidate 2 mg/mL from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. with pharmacist verification and dose recalculation — approved by Pharmacist.
3. Procure etomidate 2 mg/mL from Civica, Inc. (alternate NDC) with pharmacist verification — approved by Pharmacist.

Not recommended: Purchase from HF Acquisition Co LLC (HealthFirst) — not on FDA shortage list and no identifiable manufacturing plant.
